def test_build_teacher_request_inputs_with_prompt_attention_mask_right_padded():
    case = {
        "input_ids": [[5, 6, 7, 8, 0, 0]],
        "attention_mask": [[1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0]],
        "prompt_attention_mask": [[1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0]],
    }
    payload = {"teacher_inputs": [case]}
    observed = run_probe(PROBE_IMPORT_AND_RUN, payload)
    result = json.loads(observed) if isinstance(observed, str) else observed
    got = result["teacher_inputs"][0]
    assert got["ok"] is True
    assert got["trimmed"] == [[5, 6, 7, 8]]
    assert got["plens"] == [2]
    assert got["clens"] == [2]
